env.userData: fresh temporary directory seeded with ./nokey-userData (one Create draft at the world step, written by gpt-5.4-mini in run A)
env.launch: rm -rf "$TMPDIR/ud-p2-nokey" && cp -R docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p2-create/nokey-userData "$TMPDIR/ud-p2-nokey" && OPENAI_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA="$TMPDIR/ud-p2-nokey" bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9333
env.why: The look pictures always use the OpenAI image provider, whatever chat model is selected, so choosing another chat provider in Settings → Model never makes the look step key-less. An empty OPENAI_API_KEY in the launch environment hides the .env key from this one process (dotenv does not override a variable that is already set) without touching .env or any saved key; the fresh userData has no saved key. With no cloud key the default chat model is Apple on-device, which is not served here, so the story cannot be written either — that is expected and not what this run checks.
env.build: main at 7a04adf + the uncommitted rev 6 phase-2 working tree (bun run dev)

model: none reachable: keyStatus().openai.set === false; chat defaults to apple-fm (not running)

actions.eval: (async()=>{const t0=Date.now(); for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const t=document.body.innerText; if(!/正在畫/.test(t)&&/no-api-key/.test(t)) return {errorAfterMs:Date.now()-t0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return 'timeout';})()

window.seed.createDrafts.list().then(async r=>{const d=await window.seed.createDrafts.read(r.value[0].draftId); return {step:d.value.step, look:d.value.look, storyStepShown: /4 · 故事/.test(document.body.innerText)};})
